content.short_description: 2-wire braid hydraulic hose, MPN 4SP-08-R2, 12.7 mm ID, 350 bar working pressure, NBR tube, conforms to SAE 100R2AT / EN 853 2SN.
content.long_description:
4SP-08-R2 is a two-wire braid reinforced hydraulic hose with a synthetic rubber (NBR) inner tube. It has a 12.7 mm inner diameter and 21.4 mm outer diameter, giving it a nominal DN12 / -08 size classification. The hose is rated for a working pressure of 350 bar and a burst pressure of 1400 bar, with a minimum bend radius of 130 mm.

Operating temperature range is -40 C to +100 C. The hose conforms to SAE 100R2AT and EN 853 2SN standards, indicating suitability for medium-to-high pressure hydraulic fluid power applications where a 2-wire braid construction is specified.

Use this hose for hydraulic circuits requiring conformance to SAE 100R2AT / EN 853 2SN at the stated pressure and temperature range. Confirm fluid compatibility with NBR tube material and check fitting compatibility with the 12.7 mm ID / 21.4 mm OD dimensions before installation.
